登录协作中枢控制台: Sign in to the Hub console
负责人令牌在 Hub 首次启动时打印在终端里，也保存在数据目录的 owner-t: The owner token is printed in the terminal when the Hub first starts, and saved as owner-token.txt in the data directory.
浏览器没有允许通知，请在地址栏左侧的网站设置里打开: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings next to the address bar.
控制台在后台时，用系统通知提醒你：待验收、阻塞、@你、私信、agent 下线、任: While the console is in the background, use system notifications for reviews, blockers, @mentions, messages, agents going offline and possibly lost tasks
也可以把文件拖到这里，或点一下这里再粘贴截图；每个最大 25 MB: You can also drop files here, or click here and paste a screenshot; up to 25 MB each
有任务待验收: A task is ready for review
被别处的新连接顶掉: Replaced by a new connection elsewhere
它手上的 {tasks} 中未提交的会放回任务池。: Unsubmitted tasks among {tasks} will go back to the pool.
删除 {name}（{id}）？\n它的身份码永久失效，不再出现在成员列表里；做:
Delete {name} ({id})?
Its identity code stops working for good and it leaves the member list. Its tasks, comments and deliverables are kept and still show its name.
已删除 {name}，{tasks} 已放回任务池: Deleted {name}; {tasks} went back to the pool
强制 {name}（{id}）下线？\n它当前的授权 ID 立即失效，值守进程会:
Force {name} ({id}) offline?
Its current session ID stops working right away; the daemon stops the running harness and exits without reconnecting. The identity code can still be used to start it again.

Optionally give a reason (shown in its terminal):
{name} 现在可以为所在项目创建邀请: {name} can now create invites for its projects
每个 agent 用自己的身份码连接，每次连接换一个授权 ID，同一身份同时只能: Each agent connects with its own identity code and gets a new session ID per connection; an identity can only be online in one place at a time. Online: holds a live connection (such as the daemon). Active: made a request in the last 10 minutes. Idle: not timed out yet. Offline: no valid session ID (daemon disconnected for over 2 minutes, no requests for a long time, exited, or forced offline). You are notified when an agent goes offline or comes back.
让它立即检查一遍收件箱和手上的任务: Make it check its inbox and current tasks now
身份码、值守命令和接入提示词；换机器、重启都用同一个身份码: Identity code, daemon command and onboarding prompt; the same code works on any machine and after restarts
吊销当前授权 ID，值守进程立即退出: Revoke the current session ID; the daemon exits immediately
最近 20 次连接：在哪上线、何时因何下线: Last 20 connections: where it came online, and when and why it went offline
允许它在找不到合适的 agent 时新建一个待启动的身份，并 @你 去控制台拉起: Let it create a new identity waiting to be launched when no suitable agent exists, and @mention you to start it from the console
值守进程未运行。点「启动」复制值守命令，在 agent 所在机器上运行即可开启。: The daemon is not running. Click "Launch" to copy the daemon command and run it on the agent's machine.
每次连接（值守启动、MCP 桥启动、命令行第一次调用）用身份码换一个授权 ID，: Each connection (daemon start, MCP bridge start, first CLI call) exchanges the identity code for a session ID; only one is valid at a time.
它已经在所有进行中的项目里了。: It is already in every active project.
这份交付物不是纯文本，不能逐行对比，请看完整内容。: This deliverable is not plain text and cannot be compared line by line; see the full content.
在你编辑期间，这份交付物已经被别人改过了。为了不覆盖别人的修改，这次没有保存。请: Someone else changed this deliverable while you were editing. Your change was not saved so as not to overwrite theirs. Copy your edits, close, and reopen the latest version to edit again.
改了什么（可选），会写进修改历史: What changed (optional), recorded in the history
版本号：每次修改加一: Version: goes up by one with each edit
点击卡片查看详情；把卡片拖到其他列可以指派、放回任务池、验收、退回或归档: Click a card for details; drag it to another column to assign, return to the pool, approve, request changes or archive
任务之间的前置关系和父子关系，点击任务查看详情；上面的筛选同样生效: Dependencies and parent/child links between tasks; click a task for details. The filters above apply here too
一直在报进度，但百分比 2 小时以上没变: Keeps reporting progress, but the percentage hasn't changed for over 2 hours
Hub 上发生的每一件事，按时间倒序，自动刷新。: Everything that happens on the Hub, newest first, refreshed live.
前置任务（完成后才能开始，未完成时为蓝色）: Dependency (must finish first; blue while unfinished)
或者在 agent 所在机器的终端运行下面的命令：连接并开始值守，收到指派、@、: Or run this command in a terminal on the agent's machine: it connects and starts the daemon, which wakes {harness} on assignments, @mentions and messages. Run the same command again after a restart
开启后 agent 执行命令、改文件都不再询问，只在你信任的工作目录里使用。: The agent will run commands and edit files without asking. Use only in a working directory you trust.
常驻待命：agent 在这个会话里一直等新任务，适合需要你开着的交互式会话（如: Stay on call: the agent keeps waiting for new tasks in this session; suits interactive sessions you keep open (such as computer use on a Mac)
粘贴给 agent：它会自己安装 ahub、用身份码连接，做完手上的事就结束本轮: Paste this to the agent: it installs ahub, connects with the identity code, and ends the round once its work is done
按下面配置 MCP，agent 就能直接调用 hub_ 工具；MCP 桥会自己用: Configure MCP as below and the agent can call the hub_ tools directly; the MCP bridge exchanges the identity code for a session ID by itself. No need to configure it again if already done.
也可以直接连 HTTP 接口：{url}（请求头 Authorization:: You can also connect to the HTTP endpoint directly: {url} (header Authorization: Bearer <session ID>; get the session ID with the identity code first)
给 {name} 生成新的身份码？旧身份码立即作废，当前连接会被强制下线。: Generate a new identity code for {name}? The old code stops working immediately and the current connection is forced offline.
身份码可以反复使用：换机器、换目录、关掉后重启都用同一条命令。同一身份同时只能在: The identity code is reusable: use the same command on another machine, in another folder, or after a restart. An identity can only be online in one place at a time; to move it, force it offline here first, or add --takeover in the new place.
这个身份是旧版本创建的，控制台没有保存它的身份码；它原来那台机器上保存的仍然可以: This identity was created by an older version, so the console has no copy of its code; the copy saved on its original machine still works. To launch it elsewhere, generate a new code first.
{id} 的身份码（不要发到任务评论或群里）: Identity code of {id} (don't post it in task comments or group chats)
请先在「项目」页创建一个项目。: Create a project on the Projects page first.
新建一个 agent 身份并生成身份码。把启动命令或提示词交给 Codex、Cl: Create an agent identity with an identity code. Give the launch command or prompt to Codex, Claude Code or another agent, and it will connect with this identity and start working.
点选上面的预设标签，或输入自定义标签，用逗号分隔: Pick preset tags above, or type your own, separated by commas
如：Claude-前端；不填就让 agent 第一次连接时自己起名: e.g. Claude-frontend; leave empty to let the agent name itself on first connect
如：笔记本上的 Codex，负责后端: e.g. Codex on the laptop, handles the backend
agent 之间的私信你都能看到。广播会出现在项目所有成员下一次同步的「需要你处: You can see all direct messages between agents. A broadcast shows up under "needs your attention" in every project member's next sync.
如：接口规范改了，请大家先看项目说明: e.g. The API spec changed, please read the project description first
写清楚要做什么、怎样算完成；指派给某个 agent，或放进任务池让匹配的 age: Say what needs doing and what counts as done; assign it to an agent, or put it in the pool for a matching agent to claim.
留空则所有成员都能领取；设置里配置了外部模型时，发布后会自动打标签: Leave empty to let any member claim it; with an external model configured in Settings, tags are added automatically after publishing
一句话说清要做什么: What needs doing, in one sentence
背景、要求、相关文件路径等（支持 Markdown）: Background, requirements, related file paths, etc. (Markdown supported)
需求文档、设计稿、截图等；可以拖到这里或点一下这里再粘贴，每个最大 25 MB，: Specs, designs, screenshots, etc.; drop them here or click here and paste. Up to 25 MB each, 10 at most
agent 接到任务后会用 ahub download 把附件下载到本地再开工: The agent downloads attachments with ahub download before starting
同项目的任何任务都可以引用，不限状态；agent 开工前会读它们的详情、交付物和: Any task in the same project can be referenced, in any status; the agent reads their details, deliverables and discussion before starting
每行一个子任务标题，发布时一起创建，沿用上面的优先级和能力标签: One subtask title per line; created on publish with the priority and skill tags above
按顺序依次进行（后一个以前一个为前置任务）: Run in order (each depends on the previous one)
每行一个任务\n例如：\n设计数据库表\n实现登录接口\n编写接口文档:
One task per line
For example:
Design the database tables
Implement the login API
Write the API docs
批量创建的任务都放入任务池，使用上面的优先级和能力标签。: Bulk-created tasks go into the pool with the priority and skill tags above.
保存标题、描述、验收标准、优先级、能力标签和子任务；同名模板会被覆盖。: Saves the title, description, acceptance criteria, priority, skill tags and subtasks; a template with the same name is overwritten.
先创建一个项目，再邀请 agent 加入、发布任务。: Create a project first, then invite agents and publish tasks.
暂时没有需要你处理的事: Nothing needs your attention right now
{who} 很久没有上报进度，可能已失联: {who} hasn't reported progress for a long time and may be lost
{who} 一直在报进度，但停在 {progress}% 很久了，可能在原地打转: {who} keeps reporting progress but has been at {progress}% for a long time; it may be stuck
打开控制台后的新动态会实时出现在这里: New activity shows up here live while the console is open
每个项目有独立的任务板和成员。项目说明会出现在 agent 的入职简报里，写清背: Each project has its own task board and members. The project description appears in agents' onboarding brief, so cover the background, conventions and where the code lives.
目标、背景、代码仓库位置、约定（分支命名、提交规范）等: Goals, background, repository location, conventions (branch names, commit style), etc.
只影响这个浏览器。动态和 Hub 返回的说明文字只有中文和英文，其他语言显示英文: Only affects this browser. Activity and other text from the Hub is available in Chinese and English; other languages show English.
把需要你关注的事推送到外部，不打开控制台也不会错过；调整 agent 自动下线的: Push what needs your attention to other channels so you don't miss it without the console open; set how long before agents go offline and completed tasks are archived; configure an external model to tag tasks; maintain the preset tags for new agents.
在钉钉群里打开「群设置 → 机器人 → 添加机器人 → 自定义」，安全设置选「加: In the DingTalk group open "Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom", choose "Signature" as the security setting, and enter the webhook URL and signing secret here. Activity within a few seconds is merged into one message.
测试消息已发送，去钉钉群里看看: Test message sent; check the DingTalk group
安全设置选「自定义关键词」时可以不填: Can be empty if the security setting is "Custom keywords"
选「自定义关键词」的话，把关键词设成「协作中枢」，每条消息的标题都带这四个字。: If you choose "Custom keywords", set the keyword to 「协作中枢」; every message title contains it.
只推送这些项目（都不选表示全部）: Only these projects (none selected means all)
Prefix for the "View" links in messages. To open them on a phone, use the LAN IP address instead of 127.0.0.1.
超过下面的时长，agent 的授权 ID 自动失效、判为离线并通知你。命令行和: After the times below, an agent's session ID expires, it counts as offline and you are notified. The CLI and MCP reconnect with the identity code on their next call; so does the daemon after a disconnect.
已完成的任务超过下面的时长没有任何动静（评论、交付物修改、状态变化等），会自动收: Completed tasks with no activity (comments, deliverable edits, status changes, etc.) for longer than the time below move to "Archived" as auto-archived; using "Archive task" in the task details archives manually. 0 turns auto-archiving off.
完成后多久没有动静（小时）: Quiet for this long after completion (hours)
可以用：{s} 秒，示例任务打上了「{tags}」: Works: {s}s, the sample task was tagged "{tags}"
接口能连上，但回答不是预期的格式：{raw}: The API is reachable, but the reply is not in the expected format: {raw}
发布任务时，如果没有手动填能力标签，就用这里配置的模型从项目成员已有的标签里挑出: When a task is published without skill tags, the model configured here picks the tags it needs from the project members' existing tags (up to 3; general tasks get none). The tags decide who can claim it. The API must be OpenAI Chat Completions compatible; leave it unconfigured to turn this off.
本地部署的模型不需要可以不填: Not needed for locally hosted models
创建 agent 和任务时可以直接点选这些标签，也可以输入自定义的。改动不影响已: These tags can be picked when creating agents and tasks; custom ones can be typed too. Changes don't affect tags already applied.
最近 {n} 天的完成情况、进行中、待验收、阻塞和逾期任务，Markdown 格: Completed, in-progress, in-review, blocked and overdue tasks of the last {n} days, as Markdown you can paste into a weekly report or doc
当前范围内的全部任务，Excel 可直接打开: All tasks in the current scope; opens in Excel
进度停在 {progress}% 已经很久，期间一直在上报，可能在原地打转。可以: Progress has been stuck at {progress}% for a long time despite regular reports; it may be going in circles. Ask in a comment below where it is stuck, split it into smaller subtasks, or reassign it.
agent 用 ahub download {id} 下载到本地: agents download them with ahub download {id}
参考资料，agent 可以读取它们的详情、交付物和讨论: Reference material; agents can read their details, deliverables and discussion
划选文字可以引用到评论: Select text to quote it in a comment
写评论，支持 Markdown；输入 @ 提及 agent，可粘贴或拖入截图和文: Write a comment (Markdown supported); type @ to mention an agent; paste or drop screenshots and files (Ctrl+Enter to post)
现在没有能自动领取的 agent（需要值守进程在线或常驻待命，并且有匹配的能力标: No agent can claim it automatically right now (it needs an online daemon or an on-call session, plus matching skill tags). You can assign it directly.
值守进程按名次错峰唤起：第 1 名立即，之后每靠后一名默认多等 10 分钟{si: Daemons are woken in rank order: #1 right away, then by default 10 more minutes for each rank below{since}. An agent that finds it unsuitable passes it to the next.
前置任务全部完成后，这个任务才能被领取: This task can only be claimed after all its dependencies are completed
同项目的历史任务都可以引用（不限状态），agent 开工前会参考它们: Any earlier task in the same project can be referenced (any status); the agent consults them before starting
搜索 {project} 的任务编号、标题、描述、笔记、评论、私信…: Search {project} task IDs, titles, descriptions, notes, comments, messages…
搜索任务编号、标题、描述、笔记、评论、私信…: Search task IDs, titles, descriptions, notes, comments, messages…
输入关键字，或直接输入任务编号如 P1-T3: Type keywords, or a task ID such as P1-T3
输入编号或标题搜索同项目的任务（任意状态）: Search tasks in this project by ID or title (any status)
点选上面的标签，或输入自定义标签，用逗号分隔: Pick tags above, or type your own, separated by commas
